description: Check an archive that ovadm::backup_create wrote: it unpacks, every file matches its checksum, the manifest is present, and (with check_host) it is from this host and its package versions match. Problems are reported in the result as status failed; package differences as warnings

archive.description: Path of the archive on this host

check_host.description: Compare the manifest's certname and package versions with this host. Default true

age_identity.description: Path of an age identity file, needed to read a .tar.gz.age archive
